key_insights: Pre-sale meta on Solana/Base is net drain on crypto - tokens raised and sent directly to exchanges without circulating in ecosystem
Funding reset after market washout makes altcoin trading cheaper from cost perspective
Meme coins require very nimble trading - either rugs or massive run-ups, need to be active or have high conviction
Altcoin sentiment at extremes - hates ETH loves SOL currently
Bitcoin is primary driver - if BTC goes down altcoins suffer harder if BTC bounces usual suspects outperform
Trader brain vs cycle investor brain - different approaches for different time horizons
Entry vs confirmation tradeoff - better entries with less confirmation or worse entries with more confirmation
ETF speculation - DOGE LTC BCH might get approval before ETH due to simplicity
Daily supports rarely being tested actually shows market strength shallow dips strong trend

summary: Cred and Duck discuss altcoin market dynamics highlighting the pre-sale meta as a net drain on crypto where teams raise tokens and send directly to exchanges. They note funding has reset after market washout making altcoin trading cheaper. Both emphasize BTC dominance over altcoins - if BTC nukes alts bleed heavily if BTC bounces usual suspects outperform. They discuss extreme sentiment - market hates ETH and loves SOL currently. Duck bullish on DOGE targeting $1 with entries below $0.15. Cred likes WIF and PEPE as meme coin plays. Both agree meme coins require very nimble trading either rugs or massive run-ups. They discuss potential ETF approvals for DOGE LTC and BCH before ETH due to simplicity.
